acceptance: Autouse fixture in tests/e2e/conftest.py (and tests/integration where needed) sets BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR to a per-test tmp dir; subprocesses inherit it
session_isolation.start() sets BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR to <session home>/benchmark_runs when unset and restores it in finish()
The DuckDB result check reads the isolated output dir and fails when no bundle is found
Proof: running the affected e2e tests leaves ~/Developer/benchmark_runs unchanged (mtime/listing before and after)
No change to tests marked live_integration that intentionally use real paths
description: Tests that call `run_benchmark` in tests/e2e/conftest.py (lines ~221-230) run the CLI via `run_cli_command` (tests/integration/_cli_e2e_utils.py:13-41) with no cwd and no BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR. `default_benchmark_runs_root` (benchbox/core/runtime_paths.py:34-39) resolves to the parent of the git repo, so output lands in ~/Developer/benchmark_runs for the main clone and every worktree. HOME isolation (tests/utilities/session_isolation.py) does not cover this path. Affected: TestDuckDBE2E, TestSQLiteE2E, TestDataFusionE2E in tests/e2e/test_local_platforms.py, tests/e2e/test_dataframe_platforms.py and others. `--force all` runs regenerate the shared datagen/tpch_sf001 cache and recreate shared SQLite/DuckDB files; parallel workers and worktrees race on them. TestDuckDBE2E::test_tpch_full_execution (~lines 45-53) checks Path("benchmark_runs") relative to the repo root, so its result validation is silently skipped.
